_schema.purpose: Spec 35 feature-parity exceptions. Covers BOTH (a) audit over-reports (a core capability that has a genuine SGS equivalent under a different name/shape, or is not meaningful for SGS) AND (b) legitimately-deferred core capabilities mapped to a Wave, AND (c) SOURCE-MISSING findings (a replaced core block has no native_wp rows in the DB) recorded against the sentinel capability "(none)". A gap is CLOSED or recorded here with a reason+wave -- NEVER silently baselined.
_schema.shape: { "sgs/block": { "core/replaces-slug": { "capabilityName": { "reason": "...", "wave": "Wave-N | over-report | native" } } } } -- keyed on the 3-tuple (block, replaces, capability), NOT a flat (block, capability) 2-tuple. This matters because a block can replace MULTIPLE core blocks (e.g. sgs/media replaces BOTH core/image and core/video) -- a 2-tuple key would silence a capability against every replaced core block at once even when it only applies to one of them.
_schema.wave_values_note: "over-report" = the audit false-flagged a genuine SGS equivalent under a different name/shape (norm() only folds case/colour/hyphen/underscore, not semantic renames) -- human-verified against the block's real attribute list, not a hardcoded alias dict (R-31-1). "native" = a WP-core-internal editor/plumbing attribute that is not a client-facing functional capability, OR the replaced core block has zero native_wp rows in the DB (SOURCE-MISSING -- an audit data-source gap, not a functional one; capability key "(none)" in that case). "Wave-N" (e.g. "Wave-parity-1", "W-nav-surface") = a genuine deferred functional gap, tracked for a future build wave.
_schema.framework_universal_note: `_framework_universal` suppresses core capabilities that SGS provides FRAMEWORK-WIDE by architecture (not a per-block functional gap). These are (1) styling supports expressed via SGS's no-inline scoped contract + universal extensions, and (2) WP inline-colour / serialisation attrs SGS deliberately rejects (Spec 32 no-inline). This is POLICY-AS-DATA (reviewable here), not a hardcoded dict in the audit logic (R-31-1).
_schema.measured_at: SHA 231ecbd4 (2026-07-31) -- 157 unexplained GAPs + 3 SOURCE-MISSING across 23 in-scope blocks, classified in full this session. See .claude/reports/2026-07-31-feature-parity-measurement.md.

_framework_universal.reason: Provided framework-wide by SGS architecture: styling via the no-inline scoped contract + universal extensions (Spec 32); WP inline-colour/serialisation attrs deliberately rejected (no-inline); plus pure editor/WP plumbing attrs (id/src/blob/placeholder/splitting/tagName/lock/metadata) that are never client-facing functional controls. Not a per-block functional parity gap. Reviewed 2026-07-19.

ariaLabel.reason: No group-level ariaLabel control on the accordion wrapper; deferred a11y control.

headingLevel.reason: No control to set the heading level used for each item's summary; deferred.

levelOptions.reason: WP-internal allowed-heading-levels list paired with headingLevel; editor plumbing, not a standalone capability.

showIcon.reason: openIcon/closeIcon customise WHICH icon shows, but there's no boolean to hide the icon entirely; deferred.

name.reason: HTML5 <details name> exclusive-group mechanism; SGS achieves exclusivity via accordion-level `allowMultiple` instead — architectural, not a per-item attr.

caption.reason: No caption/description text control on sgs/audio; deferred.

prefersTaxonomy.reason: No control to prefer a taxonomy archive over the post type archive in the trail; deferred, niche.

showCurrentItem.reason: No toggle to hide the current (non-linked) page from the trail; deferred.

showOnHomePage.reason: No toggle to suppress the whole breadcrumb trail on the homepage; deferred.

borderRadius.reason: Provided by the native `__experimentalBorder` support (framework-universal styling contract).

title.reason: No HTML `title` tooltip-text control; deferred (ariaLabel covers accessible name, not the visual tooltip).

type.reason: Equivalent to `isSubmit` (boolean covers the submit/button distinction).

templateLock.reason: WP InnerBlocks editor-lock mechanism; internal editor plumbing, not a client-facing capability.

width.reason: core/column's per-child percentage width has no direct sgs/container equivalent (grid-ratio columns via gridTemplateColumns are the nearest analogue but not a literal per-child width control); deferred.

isStackedOnMobile.reason: Achieved via responsive `gridTemplateColumnsMobile`/`gridTemplateColumnsTablet` — mobile stacking is the default responsive behaviour, not a separate toggle.

ariaLabel.reason: No landmark aria-label control on the container wrapper; deferred a11y control.

(none).reason: core/row has no native_wp rows in the DB (newer WP core block not yet ingested) — re-run /sgs-update; not a functional gap, an audit data-source gap.
core/stack has no native_wp rows in the DB (newer WP core block not yet ingested) — re-run /sgs-update; not a functional gap, an audit data-source gap.

action.reason: SGS forms submit exclusively via the plugin's own secured REST endpoint (nonce + rate-limit + honeypot) — an external action URL is deliberately not exposed; see plugin CLAUDE.md forms architecture.

email.reason: SGS forms notify via N8N webhooks, not wp_mail/a per-block email attr — documented plugin architecture (plugins/sgs-blocks/CLAUDE.md).

method.reason: SGS forms always POST to the REST endpoint by design (GET forms are a security anti-pattern); not a configurable capability.

submissionMethod.reason: Same fixed-pipeline architecture as `action`/`method` — one secure server-side processing path, no mode selector needed.

(none).reason: core/form-submit-button has no native_wp rows in the DB — re-run /sgs-update once WP re-ingests this sub-block; not a functional gap, an audit data-source gap.

allowResize.reason: Editor-only per-image manual-resize handle; internal editor UI, not a functional capability.

caption.reason: Per-image captions are supported inside the `mediaItems` repeater (gated by `showCaptions`) — a nested object field, invisible to the DB's flat attr-name scan.

fixedHeight.reason: Achieved via `aspectRatio`, which locks uniform image dimensions across the grid.

ids.reason: Attachment IDs live inside the `mediaItems`/`images` repeater objects — nested, invisible to the flat attr-name scan.

imageCrop.reason: No cover/contain crop toggle for gallery images; deferred.

linkTarget.reason: Gallery images only support the lightbox interaction model (`enableLightbox`); no click-through-to-URL + new-tab option. Deferred.

navigationButtonType.reason: Editor-only crop-navigation UI control; internal plumbing.

randomOrder.reason: No shuffle/random-order toggle; deferred, low priority.

shortCodeTransforms.reason: WP core [gallery]-shortcode back-compat migration plumbing; not a functional capability.

images.reason: Renamed, not lost. core/gallery's `images` array is `mediaItems` on sgs/gallery (the 2026-05-05 media-slot migration). The legacy `images` attr was a read-only render.php fallback with no editor control and was removed 2026-08-03 once Bean confirmed there is no live content to preserve (D270 pre-production). The capability is fully present; this audit compares core attribute NAMES and cannot see a rename.

levelOptions.reason: WP-internal allowed-heading-levels restriction list; editor plumbing paired with `level`.

alt.reason: Hero background images are decorative CSS backgrounds (WCAG permits omitting alt text for purely decorative backgrounds); not a content image needing alt text.

backgroundType.reason: Determined implicitly by which of `backgroundImage`/`bgVideo` is populated — functionally equivalent, just not an explicit enum toggle.

contentPosition.reason: Achieved by combining `verticalAlign` + `textAlignDesktop`/`Tablet`/`Mobile` — together they cover the same 9-point content-position grid.

customOverlayColor.reason: Equivalent to `backgroundOverlayColour`. Reworded 2026-08-13 — this entry previously named the LEGACY `overlayColour` attribute, deleted outright at D596 (no deprecation, per D270) in favour of the canonical `backgroundOverlayColour`, which the shared BackgroundPanel's DesignTokenPicker writes.

overlayColor.reason: core/cover's `overlayColor` (theme-preset colour SLUG) and `customOverlayColor` (raw hex) are BOTH satisfied by the single `backgroundOverlayColour` control — its DesignTokenPicker (`disableCustomColors={false}`, src/components/DesignTokenPicker.js:92) offers theme-palette presets AND a custom hex picker in one UI, matching core's preset+custom pairing without needing two separate attrs. Never had its own exception entry (only `customOverlayColor` did) until surfaced by npm run build's feature-parity gate on 2026-08-13, unrelated to that session's hero effect-toggle work — pre-existing since D596's overlayColour->backgroundOverlayColour rename, first caught here.

focalPoint.reason: No precise x/y focal-point picker for the background image — only preset `backgroundPosition` keywords (center/top/etc.); deferred.

isDark.reason: WP-internal computed readability flag (auto light/dark text-over-image); not a user-facing control.

isRepeated.reason: No tiled/repeated-background-pattern mode; hero backgrounds are always cover/no-repeat. Deferred, niche.

isUserOverlayColor.reason: WP-internal flag marking whether the overlay colour was explicitly user-set vs default; plumbing.

minHeightUnit.reason: `minHeight`/`minHeightMobile`/`minHeightTablet` have no accompanying unit attr (px assumed); deferred.

poster.reason: No poster-image control for the background video; deferred.

sizeSlug.reason: Hero backgrounds are always rendered full-bleed/full-resolution — a thumbnail-size preset is not a meaningful use case for a full-viewport background.

useFeaturedImage.reason: No dynamic binding to the current post's featured image as the hero background; deferred.

focalPoint.reason: Same focal-point gap as core/cover — only preset position keywords, no x/y picker; deferred.

href.reason: No click-through link on the split-layout media panel itself; deferred, niche.

isStackedOnMobile.reason: Split hero layout always stacks to a single column at the mobile breakpoint (`splitImageMobile`/`splitContentOrderMobile`) — built-in responsive behaviour, not a separate toggle.

linkClass.reason: Plumbing attr tied to the same deferred `href` capability above; no standalone need until href ships.

mediaAlt.reason: No alt-text control for the hero's split/media image — genuine accessibility gap, worth prioritising over the other hero deferrals.

mediaId.reason: No attachment-ID reference stored for the split image (URL-only); deferred — verify whether this blocks any WP media-library re-selection workflow.

mediaPosition.reason: Equivalent to the hero `variant`/split-layout attrs (`splitImage`, layout direction) which already control left/right media placement.

mediaSizeSlug.reason: No image-size preset for the split media image; deferred.

mediaType.reason: Implicit from which media attrs are populated (image vs video), same pattern as `backgroundType` on core/cover.

useFeaturedImage.reason: Same deferred dynamic-featured-image binding as core/cover.

icon.reason: Covered by the richer `iconName`/`iconSource`/`dashiconName`/`wpIconName`/`emojiChar` multi-source icon-picker family.

aspectRatio.reason: No aspect-ratio-lock control for a single media image (height/width/max-* are absolute, not ratio-based); deferred.

focalPoint.reason: Covered functionally by `objectPosition` (preset position keywords achieve the same crop-focus outcome as a free x/y focal point).

lightbox.reason: No click-to-enlarge lightbox on a single sgs/media image (lightbox exists on sgs/gallery only); deferred.

linkClass.reason: Plumbing/niche — no custom CSS class control specifically for the generated link wrapper; deferred, low priority.

linkDestination.reason: `linkUrl` covers the common custom-URL case; the WP-specific 'attachment page' destination is not applicable outside wp-admin media workflows.

sizeSlug.reason: No image-size preset selector on sgs/media (unlike sgs/gallery's `imageSize`); deferred.

title.reason: No HTML `title` tooltip-text control; deferred (same pattern as sgs/button `title`).

preload.reason: No preload-strategy control for direct video (audio has `audioPreload`, video does not); deferred.

tracks.reason: No captions/subtitles-track support for direct video — genuine accessibility gap, worth prioritising.

__unstableLocation.reason: WP core experimental/unstable internal attr; explicitly marked unstable by WP itself, not a capability to match.

customOverlayBackgroundColor.reason: Mobile-drawer surface colour — closing under the nav-menu drawer-surface workstream, tracked separately; do not duplicate.

customOverlayTextColor.reason: Mobile-drawer surface colour — closing under the nav-menu drawer-surface workstream.

overlay.reason: Mobile-drawer surface presentation — closing under the nav-menu drawer-surface workstream.

overlayBackgroundColor.reason: Mobile-drawer surface colour — closing under the nav-menu drawer-surface workstream.

overlayMenu.reason: Distinct from the 5 surface-colour attrs above: this is the on/off mode toggle for whether mobile uses the overlay/drawer presentation at all (sgs/nav-menu's `<dialog>` drawer is always the mobile mode — no alternate 'default' mobile mode to toggle between). Deferred if an alternate mode is ever wanted.

overlayTextColor.reason: Mobile-drawer surface colour — closing under the nav-menu drawer-surface workstream.

rgbBackgroundColor.reason: WP-internal computed RGB value (contrast-calculation helper) derived from the chosen colour; not a user-facing control.

showSubmenuIcon.reason: Covered by `indicatorStyle` (default `'none'`) — setting it to `'none'` is the equivalent of hiding the submenu indicator.

submenuVisibility.reason: No explicit click-vs-hover submenu-open-trigger control; deferred.

addLinkToFeaturedImage.reason: Each post card is already a single whole-card link (cardStyle) — the featured image is inherently linked, no separate toggle needed.

displayPostContentRadio.reason: Paired enum plumbing for `displayPostContent`/`showExcerpt` — excerpt-vs-full-content choice; bundled with that capability.

featuredImageAlign.reason: No control for the featured-image position within the card (left/right/top); deferred.

featuredImageSizeHeight.reason: Covered by the `imageSize` preset selector (fixed numeric height not exposed, but preset sizing achieves the same practical outcome).

postLayout.reason: Grid/list presentation is controlled by sgs/post-grid's own `layout`/`gridTemplateColumns`/column attrs — a richer, more general layout engine than core's grid/list enum.

textAlign.reason: No text-alignment control on sgs/quote; deferred.

value.reason: Quote text is child-owned via InnerBlocks (sgs/text child), per the project's HC2 parent-owns-layout/child-owns-content pattern — not a scalar attr on the parent.

textAlign.reason: No text-alignment control on sgs/quote; deferred.

value.reason: Same InnerBlocks child-owned-content architecture as core/pullquote `value`.

linkTarget.reason: Logo link always opens in the same tab; no new-tab toggle. Deferred, niche.

shouldSyncIcon.reason: WP-native Site Icon sync toggle — internal plumbing tied to a separate WP Customizer setting, not an SGS block capability.

label.reason: Per-icon label lives inside the `icons` repeater objects — nested, invisible to the flat attr-name scan.

rel.reason: No explicit per-icon rel control; deferred (verify whether rel=noopener is auto-applied at render).

service.reason: Per-icon service/platform lives inside the `icons` repeater objects — nested.

url.reason: Per-icon URL lives inside the `icons` repeater objects — nested.

iconBackgroundColor.reason: No separate icon-shape background-colour control distinct from `iconColour` (foreground); deferred.

showLabels.reason: No global toggle to show text labels alongside icons; deferred.

ariaLabel.reason: No landmark aria-label control on the TOC wrapper; deferred.

headings.reason: sgs/table-of-contents is a dynamic block that recomputes headings live server-side each render, rather than caching a `headings` array attr — an architectural equivalent, arguably more robust (always current).

maxLevel.reason: Equivalent to `headingLevels` (array of included levels covers min/max level selection).

onlyIncludeCurrentPage.reason: No pagination-aware scoping control; deferred, niche (relevant only to paginated posts).

ordered.reason: Covered by `listStyle` (ordered vs unordered is one of its style options).

activeTabIndex.reason: core/tabs is itself an experimental WP core block; this is its internal default-active-tab state attr — SGS's own tabs interactivity handles active-tab state client-side instead.

editorActiveTabIndex.reason: Explicitly editor-only internal state attr per its own name; pure editor plumbing.

direction.reason: No RTL/LTR text-direction control; deferred (i18n/a11y relevant).
